units: H = 2.30 scene units = the SHARED motion unit (Muse's; root_*, foot_*, props and places are in it). Juno's real stature is stature_scene. World frame = (p_scene - origin_scene)/H, x screen-right, y up, z toward the camera

arm.hand_target: upper-body space (spine_03's): wrist = wrist_rest + (s*(hx>0 ? gain_x_out : gain_x_in)*L*hx, gain_y*L*hy, gain_z*L*hz), s = -1 screen-left; |x| >= min_x; pushed out of the chest ellipsoid; an EMPTY hand coming to the face rests on its surface in front (head inflated by the hand); reach clamped to 0.995 L; clavicle shares far reaches; rig.py JunoRig._clavicle
arm.grasp: grasp = palm contact + 0.022 * palm normal; frame columns = across the palm, toward the fingertips, out of the palm (museGrasp's convention)

leg.foot_target: ankle = ankle_rest + root_linear^-1 * (H * foot_{l,r}_{x,y,z}) (WORLD-axis offsets in H, as Muse); knees bend forward (pole slightly out); reach clamped to 0.995*(thigh+shin)

step.notes: a grown woman's walk in the shared H unit: steps ~0.15-0.17 H (0.35-0.39 su), lift ~0.04 H

sitting.root_y_for_seat: root_y = (seat_height_scene - 1.091)/2.30 (seat top above the floor, scene units)
sitting.notes: the shared chair (seat 0.44 su) is low for her: knees sit a little above the hips, feet flat in front

hand_map.note: rig.py, numbers for code: upper-body wrist = rest_wrist + (s*gain_x*L*hx, gain_y*L*hy, gain_z*L*hz), s = -1 screen-left; gain_x = gain_x_out for hx > 0 else gain_x_in; |x| >= min_x

face.units: head space: origin = head_scene (the head centre at rest), x OUTWARD on the hand's own side, y up, z out of the face; scene units. Where a palm goes for a face touch; the rig rests it on the face.
face.note: rig: generated by renderer/humans/tools/juno_body_build.py from the asset landmarks + rig.py

nod.note: : a human head framed full-body; between the seated characters' 1.0 and Muse's 2.4

home.note: rig2: medium close-up (crown-chin = head_frac of the frame, eyes eye_from_top down). center_y / head_y: the frame centre and the head centre at rest (H); the page keeps their difference while aiming at the live head. Raised hands (above the frame bottom) and held things must stay inside half_w / half_h shrunk by margin, else it eases out (out_hz) to the follow framing; back in (in_hz) after settle_s still

stand_note: Juno STANDS by default (root_y 0 = standing on her feet); the 'stand' param is ignored
notes: rig: generated by renderer/humans/tools/juno_body_build.py from the asset skeleton + renderer/humans/rig.py
